How it works

Three ways membership pays

Every woman member is an owner of Shreeja. She invests in shares, and the company returns money to her every year.

1

Share capital

Members buy shares in their own milk producer company. The shares stay theirs, and they have a say in how the company is run.

2

Dividend

Each year, part of the company's profit is paid back on the shares a member holds, straight into her bank account.

3

Bonus

Bonus is paid back on the milk a member pours. The more regularly she pours to Shreeja, the bigger her bonus.

Paid back, year after year

Dividend and bonus paid to all members in each financial year.
